+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

+// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
+// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force
+// evaluation and integration to share one kernel launch.
+template <int BlockSize>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ outX,
+                   double* __restrict__ outY,
+                   double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ velX,
+                   double* __restrict__ velY,
+                   double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                   const int count) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+

+        const int sourceIndex = tile * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;

+        tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+        tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
+        __syncwarp();
+
+#pragma unroll 16
+        for (int j = 0; j < BlockSize; ++j) {

+            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;

+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;

+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);

+    }

+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }

+    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }

+    double* positionZ_[2]{};
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,

+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {

+

+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();

+// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
+// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force
+// evaluation and integration to share one kernel launch.
+template <int BlockSize>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,

+                   const int count) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    double* positionX(const int buffer) const { return positionX_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }
+    double* velocityY() const { return velocityY_; }
+    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }
+
+private:
+    size_t stride_ = 0;
+    double* storage_ = nullptr;
+    double* positionX_[2]{};
+    double* positionY_[2]{};
+    double* positionZ_[2]{};
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
+};

+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

+// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
+// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force

+template <int BlockSize>

+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,

+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];

+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    double* positionX(const int buffer) const { return positionX_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }
+    double* velocityY() const { return velocityY_; }
+    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }
+
+private:
+    size_t stride_ = 0;
+    double* storage_ = nullptr;
+    double* positionX_[2]{};
+    double* positionY_[2]{};
+    double* positionZ_[2]{};
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
+};

+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

+// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
+// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force
+// evaluation and integration to share one kernel launch.
+template <int BlockSize>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ outX,
+                   double* __restrict__ outY,

+                   const int count) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    double* positionX(const int buffer) const { return positionX_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }
+    double* velocityY() const { return velocityY_; }
+    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }
+
+private:
+    size_t stride_ = 0;
+    double* storage_ = nullptr;
+    double* positionX_[2]{};
+    double* positionY_[2]{};
+    double* positionZ_[2]{};
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
+};

+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

+// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
+// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force
+// evaluation and integration to share one kernel launch.
+template <int BlockSize>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ outX,
+                   double* __restrict__ outY,
+                   double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ velX,
+                   double* __restrict__ velY,
+                   double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                   const int count) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    const int fullTileCount = count / BlockSize;
+    for (int tile = 0; tile < fullTileCount; ++tile) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tile * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+        tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
+        tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+        tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
+        __syncwarp();
+
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < BlockSize; ++j) {
+            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    const int remainder = count - fullTileCount * BlockSize;
+    if (remainder != 0) {
+        const int sourceIndex = fullTileCount * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+        if (threadIdx.x < remainder) {
+            tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
+            tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < remainder; ++j) {
+            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
-        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
     }
+
+    if (active) {
+        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
+        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
+        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
+        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
+        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
+        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;
+        outX[bodyIndex] = bodyX + newVelocityX * DT;
+        outY[bodyIndex] = bodyY + newVelocityY * DT;
+        outZ[bodyIndex] = bodyZ + newVelocityZ * DT;
+    }

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    double* positionX(const int buffer) const { return positionX_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }
+    double* velocityY() const { return velocityY_; }
+    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }
+
+private:
+    size_t stride_ = 0;
+    double* storage_ = nullptr;
+    double* positionX_[2]{};
+    double* positionY_[2]{};
+    double* positionZ_[2]{};
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
+};
+
+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

+// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
+// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force
+// evaluation and integration to share one kernel launch.
+template <int BlockSize>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ outX,
+                   double* __restrict__ outY,
+                   double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ velX,
+                   double* __restrict__ velY,
+                   double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                   const int count) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    const int fullTileCount = count / BlockSize;
+    for (int tile = 0; tile < fullTileCount; ++tile) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tile * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+        tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
+        tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+        tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
+        __syncwarp();
+
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < BlockSize; ++j) {
+            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    const int remainder = count - fullTileCount * BlockSize;
+    if (remainder != 0) {
+        const int sourceIndex = fullTileCount * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+        if (threadIdx.x < remainder) {
+            tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
+            tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < remainder; ++j) {
+            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
-        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;

+    if (active) {
+        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
+        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
+        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
+        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
+        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
+        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;

+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

codex
The tuned kernel now uses one warp-sized block per target group. That keeps each body’s force summation in the original source order, while spreading small/default workloads over many more SMs; on the available RTX 3090 this reduced the 1024-body, 10-step kernel time from roughly 14 ms to 3 ms, with no material numerical drift from the CPU reference.

+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)

+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;

+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }

+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;

+    ~DeviceBodies() {

+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }

+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }

+// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
+// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force
+// evaluation and integration to share one kernel launch.
+template <int BlockSize>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ outX,
+                   double* __restrict__ outY,
+                   double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ velX,
+                   double* __restrict__ velY,
+                   double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                   const int count) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    double* positionX(const int buffer) const { return positionX_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }
+    double* velocityY() const { return velocityY_; }
+    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }
+

+    double* positionZ_[2]{};
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,

+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];

+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);
+        }
+    }
+

+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }

+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

    53	// Every thread advances one body. Positions are double-buffered so all force
    54	// calculations in a step see the same input positions; this also allows force
    55	// evaluation and integration to share one kernel launch.
    56	template <int BlockSize>
    57	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
    58	void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
    59	                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
    60	                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,
    61	                   double* __restrict__ outX,
    62	                   double* __restrict__ outY,
    63	                   double* __restrict__ outZ,
    64	                   double* __restrict__ velX,
    65	                   double* __restrict__ velY,
    66	                   double* __restrict__ velZ,
    67	                   const int count) {
    68	    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
    69	    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
    70	    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
    71	
    72	    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
    73	    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
    74	    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
    75	    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
    76	    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
    77	    double forceX = 0.0;
    78	    double forceY = 0.0;
    79	    double forceZ = 0.0;
    80	
    81	    const int fullTileCount = count / BlockSize;
    82	    for (int tile = 0; tile < fullTileCount; ++tile) {
    83	        const int sourceIndex = tile * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
    84	        tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
    85	        tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
    86	        tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
    87	        __syncwarp();
    88	
    89	#pragma unroll 8
    90	        for (int j = 0; j < BlockSize; ++j) {
    91	            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
    92	            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
    93	            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
    94	            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
    95	            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
    96	            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
    97	            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
    98	            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
    99	            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
   100	        }
   101	        __syncwarp();
   102	    }
   103	
   104	    const int remainder = count - fullTileCount * BlockSize;
   105	    if (remainder != 0) {
   106	        const int sourceIndex = fullTileCount * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
   107	        if (threadIdx.x < remainder) {
   108	            tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
   109	            tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
   110	            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
   111	        }
   112	        __syncwarp();
   113	
   114	#pragma unroll 8
   115	        for (int j = 0; j < remainder; ++j) {
   116	            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
   117	            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
   118	            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
   119	            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
   120	            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
   121	            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
   122	            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
   123	            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
   124	            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
   125	        }
   126	    }
   127	
   128	    if (active) {
   129	        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
   130	        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
   131	        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
   132	        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
   133	        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
   134	        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;
   135	        outX[bodyIndex] = bodyX + newVelocityX * DT;
   136	        outY[bodyIndex] = bodyY + newVelocityY * DT;
   137	        outZ[bodyIndex] = bodyZ + newVelocityZ * DT;
   138	    }
   139	}

   141	// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
   142	// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
   143	class DeviceBodies {
   144	public:
   145	    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
   146	        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
   147	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
   148	                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
   149	        positionX_[0] = storage_;
   150	        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
   151	        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
   152	        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
   153	        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
   154	        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
   155	        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
   156	        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
   157	        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
   158	    }
   159	
   160	    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
   161	    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
   162	
   163	    ~DeviceBodies() {
   164	        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
   165	            cudaFree(storage_);
   166	        }
   167	    }
   168	
   169	    double* positionX(const int buffer) const { return positionX_[buffer]; }
   170	    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
   171	    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
   172	    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }
   173	    double* velocityY() const { return velocityY_; }
   174	    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }
   175	
   176	private:
   177	    size_t stride_ = 0;
   178	    double* storage_ = nullptr;
   179	    double* positionX_[2]{};
   180	    double* positionY_[2]{};
   181	    double* positionZ_[2]{};
   182	    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
   183	    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
   184	    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
   185	};

   187	long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
   188	                            const bool copyResults) {
   189	    const size_t count = bodies.size();
   190	    if (count == 0) {
   191	        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
   192	        // deliberately the only execution backend.
   193	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
   194	        return 0;
   195	    }
   196	
   197	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
   198	    DeviceBodies device(count);
   199	
   200	    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
   201	    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
   202	    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
   203	    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
   204	    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
   205	    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
   206	    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
   207	
   208	    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
   209	        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
   210	        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
   211	        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
   212	        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
   213	        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
   214	        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
   215	    }
   216	
   217	    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
   218	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   219	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   220	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   221	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   222	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   223	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   224	
   225	    int inputBuffer = 0;
   226	    int outputBuffer = 1;
   227	    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
   228	
   229	    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   230	    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
   231	        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
   232	            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
   233	            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
   234	            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
   235	        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
   236	    }
   237	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   238	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   239	    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   240	
   241	    if (copyResults) {
   242	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   243	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   244	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   245	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   246	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   247	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   248	
   249	        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
   250	            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
   251	            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
   252	        }
   253	    }
   254	
   255	    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
   256	}
   257	
   258	double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
   259	    double energy = 0.0;
   260	    const size_t n = bodies.size();
   261	
   262	    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
   263	    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
   264	        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +
   265	                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +
   266	                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
   267	    }
   268	
   269	    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
   270	    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
   271	        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
   272	            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
   273	            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
   274	            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
   275	            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
   276	            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
   277	        }
   278	    }
   279	
   280	    return energy;
   281	}

+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,

+// Device arrays use a structure-of-arrays layout so every warp performs
+// contiguous global-memory accesses. A padded stride keeps each array aligned.
+class DeviceBodies {
+public:
+    explicit DeviceBodies(const size_t count)
+        : stride_((count + 31u) & ~size_t{31u}) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&storage_),
+                              9u * stride_ * sizeof(double)));
+        positionX_[0] = storage_;
+        positionY_[0] = positionX_[0] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[0] = positionY_[0] + stride_;
+        positionX_[1] = positionZ_[0] + stride_;
+        positionY_[1] = positionX_[1] + stride_;
+        positionZ_[1] = positionY_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityX_ = positionZ_[1] + stride_;
+        velocityY_ = velocityX_ + stride_;
+        velocityZ_ = velocityY_ + stride_;
+    }
+
+    DeviceBodies(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+    DeviceBodies& operator=(const DeviceBodies&) = delete;
+
+    ~DeviceBodies() {
+        if (storage_ != nullptr) {
+            cudaFree(storage_);
+        }
+    }
+
+    double* positionX(const int buffer) const { return positionX_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionY(const int buffer) const { return positionY_[buffer]; }
+    double* positionZ(const int buffer) const { return positionZ_[buffer]; }
+    double* velocityX() const { return velocityX_; }
+    double* velocityY() const { return velocityY_; }
+    double* velocityZ() const { return velocityZ_; }
+
+private:
+    size_t stride_ = 0;
+    double* storage_ = nullptr;
+    double* positionX_[2]{};
+    double* positionY_[2]{};
+    double* positionZ_[2]{};
+    double* velocityX_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityY_ = nullptr;
+    double* velocityZ_ = nullptr;
+};

+long long runSimulationCuda(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const int steps,
+                            const bool copyResults) {
+    const size_t count = bodies.size();
+    if (count == 0) {
+        // Initialize the CUDA runtime even for this degenerate case: CUDA is
+        // deliberately the only execution backend.
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+        return 0;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
+    DeviceBodies device(count);
+
+    std::vector<double> hostState(6u * count);
+    double* const hostX = hostState.data();
+    double* const hostY = hostX + count;
+    double* const hostZ = hostY + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityX = hostZ + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityY = hostVelocityX + count;
+    double* const hostVelocityZ = hostVelocityY + count;
+
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        hostX[i] = bodies[i].pos.x;
+        hostY[i] = bodies[i].pos.y;
+        hostZ[i] = bodies[i].pos.z;
+        hostVelocityX[i] = bodies[i].vel.x;
+        hostVelocityY[i] = bodies[i].vel.y;
+        hostVelocityZ[i] = bodies[i].vel.z;
     }
+
+    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(double);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionX(0), hostX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionY(0), hostY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.positionZ(0), hostZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityX(), hostVelocityX, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityY(), hostVelocityY, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device.velocityZ(), hostVelocityZ, bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+    int inputBuffer = 0;
+    int outputBuffer = 1;
+    const int blockCount = static_cast<int>((count + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1u) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+
+    const auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+    for (int step = 0; step < steps; ++step) {
+        advanceBodies<CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE><<<blockCount, CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
+            device.positionX(inputBuffer), device.positionY(inputBuffer), device.positionZ(inputBuffer),
+            device.positionX(outputBuffer), device.positionY(outputBuffer), device.positionZ(outputBuffer),
+            device.velocityX(), device.velocityY(), device.velocityZ(), static_cast<int>(count));
+        std::swap(inputBuffer, outputBuffer);
+    }
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
+    const auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
+
+    if (copyResults) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostX, device.positionX(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostY, device.positionY(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostZ, device.positionZ(inputBuffer), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityX, device.velocityX(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityY, device.velocityY(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostVelocityZ, device.velocityZ(), bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+            bodies[i].pos = Vec3(hostX[i], hostY[i], hostZ[i]);
+            bodies[i].vel = Vec3(hostVelocityX[i], hostVelocityY[i], hostVelocityZ[i]);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
 }

codex
Implemented unconditional CUDA acceleration while preserving FP64 simulation semantics and the `nbody` executable name.

Key changes:

- Warp-tiled CUDA force kernel with coalesced structure-of-arrays storage.
- Double-buffered positions, allowing force calculation and integration in one kernel per step.
- Native GPU architecture compilation and `-O3` CUDA optimization.
- CUDA error handling with no CPU fallback.
- No new source files or external dependencies.

Validation completed:

- Default 1024-body validation passed in ~3 ms on RTX 3090.
- Partial blocks, single body, and zero bodies passed.
- CPU reference comparison showed only expected FP64 rounding differences.
- CUDA memcheck: 0 errors.
- CUDA racecheck: 0 hazards.

+template <int BlockSize>
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BlockSize)
+void advanceBodies(const double* __restrict__ inX,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inY,
+                   const double* __restrict__ inZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ outX,
+                   double* __restrict__ outY,
+                   double* __restrict__ outZ,
+                   double* __restrict__ velX,
+                   double* __restrict__ velY,
+                   double* __restrict__ velZ,
+                   const int count) {
+    __shared__ double tileX[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileY[BlockSize];
+    __shared__ double tileZ[BlockSize];
+
+    const int bodyIndex = blockIdx.x * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+    const bool active = bodyIndex < count;
+    const double bodyX = active ? inX[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyY = active ? inY[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    const double bodyZ = active ? inZ[bodyIndex] : 0.0;
+    double forceX = 0.0;
+    double forceY = 0.0;
+    double forceZ = 0.0;
+
+    const int fullTileCount = count / BlockSize;
+    for (int tile = 0; tile < fullTileCount; ++tile) {
+        const int sourceIndex = tile * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+        tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
+        tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+        tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
+        __syncwarp();
+
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < BlockSize; ++j) {
+            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+    }
+
+    const int remainder = count - fullTileCount * BlockSize;
+    if (remainder != 0) {
+        const int sourceIndex = fullTileCount * BlockSize + threadIdx.x;
+        if (threadIdx.x < remainder) {
+            tileX[threadIdx.x] = inX[sourceIndex];
+            tileY[threadIdx.x] = inY[sourceIndex];
+            tileZ[threadIdx.x] = inZ[sourceIndex];
+        }
+        __syncwarp();
+
+#pragma unroll 8
+        for (int j = 0; j < remainder; ++j) {
+            const double dx = tileX[j] - bodyX;
+            const double dy = tileY[j] - bodyY;
+            const double dz = tileZ[j] - bodyZ;
+            const double distanceSquared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+            const double inverseDistance = rsqrt(distanceSquared);
+            const double inverseDistanceCubed = inverseDistance * inverseDistance * inverseDistance;
+            forceX += dx * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceY += dy * inverseDistanceCubed;
+            forceZ += dz * inverseDistanceCubed;
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
-        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
     }
+
+    if (active) {
+        const double newVelocityX = velX[bodyIndex] + DT * forceX;
+        const double newVelocityY = velY[bodyIndex] + DT * forceY;
+        const double newVelocityZ = velZ[bodyIndex] + DT * forceZ;
+        velX[bodyIndex] = newVelocityX;
+        velY[bodyIndex] = newVelocityY;
+        velZ[bodyIndex] = newVelocityZ;
+        outX[bodyIndex] = bodyX + newVelocityX * DT;
+        outY[bodyIndex] = bodyY + newVelocityY * DT;
+        outZ[bodyIndex] = bodyZ + newVelocityZ * DT;
+    }
